messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2a. Error spike started ~1860002200. Rolling aggregated error rate = 18% over 5m. Paging on-call.

jamie.ops: seeing the same in dashboard — p50 latency also up. correlated with increased tcp retransmits in host-net metrics.

tony-oncall: I'm on it. starting a quick triage. pinging net-eng @mike-neteng and runtime @ravi-runtime.

mike-neteng: looking at route tables and ENI metrics for us-west-2a. I see repeated ENI detach/attach events on several worker nodes in the g4-inference-asg. Possible hypervisor network side degradation.

ravi-runtime: logs from runtime show lots of `Connection reset by peer` in the grpc layer and `KV cache miss` spikes. Batching latency climbing.

elaine-support: customer-facing: a handful of paid customers reported timeouts and elevated error rate about 10m ago. No PII impacted, mostly generation timeouts and 502s.

jamie.ops: impact estimate: ~5% of hosted API traffic routed to us-west-2a; of that ~35% is on the model pool that runs on the affected nodes. so approx 1.75% global customers get degraded responses but a few high-commitment tenants are seeing larger effect.

tony-oncall: temporary mitigations: 1) exclude the affected subnet from routing for the next 10m via smart-router policy, 2) scale up fallback pool in us-west-2b and cross-region steer heavy-tenants. Starting those now.

ravi-runtime: starting automated model fallbacks for high-latency requests — lowering max_tokens and switching to quantized variant where possible. Will update routing config after confirm.

mike-neteng: I triggered NLB target health checks to mark targets unhealthy for the impacted ENIs to drain traffic off gracefully. Also seeing increased NAT gateway queuing for some nodes — could be saturating egress.

jamie.ops: paste of quick healthcheck I ran:

```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}'
HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
content-length: 0
```

sarah-sre: thanks. if NLB draining doesn't work, we should consider increasing DNS TTL to force clients to pick other endpoints, but that is noisy. Any idea how long this will take to surface?

mike-neteng: I'm seeing 100s of ENI reset events across 3 hosts in us-west-2a. Opening a support case with AWS with logs. ETA unknown. For now NLB drain + smart-router exclude should reduce impact in ~2-5m.

tony-oncall: executed smart-router change: exclude us-west-2a-subnet-3 from preferred routing for hosted-api. Rolling change applied to 100% at 1860002380.

ravi-runtime: canary of fallback routing looks good: 5m window shows error rate back down to 3% across the API. Still seeing higher latencies for some streaming sessions.

elaine-support: notified impacted customers and gave ETA 30m while we investigate. Marked high-touch customers for an engineer callback.

jamie.ops: double-checking dedicated customers: none of the Dedicated clusters in us-west-2a are impacted — they are isolated. Confirmed with product and config.

mike-neteng: AWS support responded: "We are investigating a networking plane degradation in us-west-2a that may affect ENI stability and route convergence." They've escalated to networking team.

ravi-runtime: action item: throttle long-running streaming sessions from affected IP ranges, apply KV cache warms to reduce churn, and disable some aggressive batching to reduce simultaneous connections for a bit. I'm on it.

tony-oncall: handing over to sarah-sre for the next shift. sarah, can you keep AWS support thread and coordinate cross-region steer?

sarah-sre: taking over. key notes: 1) AWS investigating ENI/network plane in us-west-2a. 2) Mitigations in place: NLB drain + smart-router exclude + auto-fallback to us-west-2b. 3) Customer comms live. 4) On-call rotation handoff to me at 1860003600.

inc-bot: Incident "usw2a-inference-networking" created and annotated. Severity: SEV2. Commander: sarah-sre.

jamie.ops: quick list of impacted services for postmortem: hosted-generate (primary), streaming-socket-proxy (partial), internal-agent-kv (transient).

mike-neteng: AWS says they see reduced errors after moving some control plane traffic; they will monitor for the next hour. We should keep the smart-router exclude for at least 30m after AWS declares healthy.

elaine-support: escalating to biz-ops: two enterprise customers asked for SLA credits and an incident call. Scheduling war room if AWS confirms prolonged outage.

sarah-sre: current state (1860003500): error rate down to baseline (~1.2%). We are keeping mitigations for another 20m and watching.

ravi-runtime: logs show KV hit rate recovering after fallbacks. Removing temporary throttles in streaming path gradually.

jamie.ops: can someone capture the exact set of nodes that exhibited ENI resets? mike, pls add to aws case ID when you have it.

mike-neteng: noted. AWS case ID 7890123451. Nodes: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, i-0b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i, i-0c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j. Adding logs and pcap.

tony-oncall: thumbs: :thumbsup: good job. I'll prep the initial incident timeline for the postmortem doc.

sarah-sre: declared Incident status: mitigation successful at 1860004400. Will keep channel open for 1h to verify no regressions. Postmortem owner: jamie.ops.

elaine-support: posting customer update summary draft for review:

"We experienced elevated error rates impacting the hosted generation API in the us-west-2a availability zone between 1860002200 and 1860004400. Root cause: AWS-reported networking/ENI instability in the AZ. Mitigations: automatic traffic steering to healthy AZs, NLB target draining, and temporary runtime fallbacks to reduce latency. Impact: some customers saw timeouts and 502s; there was no data loss. We will follow up with a full postmortem and SLA evaluation."

jamie.ops: looks good. small edits done.

inc-bot: Incident "usw2a-inference-networking" updated: status=mitigated, sev=SEV2, commander=sarah-sre.

sarah-sre: closing handoff notes: next steps: 1) postmortem (jamie.ops) 2) update router automation to allow faster AZ-exclusion (ravi-runtime + mike-neteng) 3) customer impact spreadsheet (elaine-support). Assign owners in the incident tracker.

jamie.ops: creating postmortem ticket now. moving to #postmortems. thanks everyone. :wave:
